newsitem.title: FINLAND: TIMETABLE FOR U.S.-RUSSIAN HELSINKI SUMMIT.
newsitem.headline: TIMETABLE FOR U.S.-RUSSIAN HELSINKI SUMMIT.

text.p: Following is the planned
timetable for the summit between U.S. President Bill Clinton and
Russian President Boris Yeltsin, which ends on Friday.
The meeting in the Finnish capital started one day later
than planned, over dinner on Thursday, because Clinton had to
undergo surgery following a knee injury last week. The main
talks take place on Friday.
All times given are local, followed by GMT.
FRIDAY MARCH 21
1000/0800 GMT - Ahtisaari greets both presidents at his
secluded residence, Mantyniemi, and leaves them to their talks.
The house is on a promontory overlooking the Baltic.
1845/1645 GMT - A news conference is planned at the nearby
Kalastajatorppa Hotel, close to the summit site.
2200/2000 GMT - Clinton leaves for Washington.
SATURDAY MARCH 22
0930/0730 GMT - Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov
and Finnish Foreign Minister Tarja Halonen give news conference.
Yeltsin and Ahtisaari have bilateral talks over lunch at
Presidential Palace. A news conference is planned to follow.
1500/1300 GMT - Yeltsin leaves for Moscow.
1600/1400 GMT - Ahtisaari holds news conference to mark end
of summit.
